title: STARTEX: Prairie Line, Normal Operations at 05:45

fields.location: Ironbark Pipeline Company: Prairie Line, Prairie Bend segment (MP 196–231), Prairie Bend County, Kansas; Pipeline Control Center, Tulsa
fields.weather: Clear and mild over Tulsa and Prairie Bend County. Light south wind. Kansas River at about 8,500 cfs, surface current near 2 knots (2.3 mph).
fields.load: Normal: about 31,000 barrels a day of medium sour crude, Hollis Gathering Terminal to Wabash Junction Terminal
fields.staffing: Control Center day shift on duty under shift supervisor Nadia Kowalczyk. QI, IMT, OSRO duty manager and water utility staff on normal call or shift.
fields.narration: STARTEX. This is an exercise. It is 05:45 Central Time on Thursday, November 12, 2026, and the day shift handover in the Ironbark Pipeline Control Center in Tulsa is complete, with Nadia Kowalczyk in the supervisor's chair. The Prairie Line is moving about 31,000 barrels a day of medium sour crude toward Wabash Junction, with about 880 psi at the Kansas River crossing at milepost 214.3. Both block valves are open and can be operated remotely, SCADA and computational pipeline monitoring are green, and everything is normal. Please state your role, where you are right now and which plan you have in front of you.

status.note: About 8,500 cfs, current near 2 knots; no reports

fields.facilitatorNote: Before you read, check that each table has its plan: the Ironbark Response Plan (Control Center, QI, Environmental Unit, PIO), the Prairie Spill Response Cooperative duty materials (OSRO) and the Sterling Bluff Water Department plan (SBWD). After reading, go around the room. Each player states role, location (Control Center, on call at home, cooperative duty phone, water plant) and plan. Remind everyone that all times are Central and all volumes are in barrels only.

instructorNote: This card sets a normal baseline with nothing hidden. Check that every player confirms role, location and plan, and set the rules for the rest of the exercise: Central time and barrels only. The card uses the official exercise date (Thursday, November 12, 2026) instead of the June 2027 date in the MSEL row, so it says Central Time rather than CDT. Tell players nothing about a leak until the next row.
